blocks.text: Having AI-generated music is already a big deal in today’s time, how much more if an AI-generated music group attempts to enter the scene? Recently, the K-pop community has been in shock over the debut of a boy group. One might think it is normal as companies debut groups from time to time, but what caught the attention of the fans is because the boy group is composed of AI-generated idols. AI-generated K-pop boy group muuo:23 entered the K-pop scene with the release of its pre-debut digital single, NEVERTHELESS.
